note: Tranche-2 capture for M1084A1R SOCOM SOV. Every value is grade claimed: the validator admits a tier-4 manufacturer source and a tier-5 compilation at claimed only, and the dataset tier note is carried in each value state. The retired capture-level sources array stays empty.

operating_weight_kg.locator: Datasheet, 'Vehicle Curb Weight with Fuel: 24,656 lb (11,184 kg)'. No SOCOM SOV-specific weight is published; the base M1084A1R 5-ton cargo figure is used as the operating basis.

gross_weight_kg.locator: Datasheet, curb 24,656 lb plus payload 10,000 lb = 34,656 lb (15,720 kg); derived.
gross_weight_kg.state: gross vehicle weight rating as published; source tier-4 manufacturer datasheet; the research dataset marked this value derived; it is not directly published, and the validator admits a real-world derived value as claimed
